newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha flat, prompt Russian asks low $170's.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha flat, prompt Russian asks low $170's.

text.p: NWE naphtha was little changed on Monday despite modest gains on crude and firmer gasoline.
"The arb to the East is still closed and we are getting Russian cargoes offered in the very low $170's," said an end user.

The loading programme from Skikda is normal and may begin to pressure July prices. The only thing that surprised us is that LPG was unchanged," he added referring to unchanged prices for Saudi Arabian propane.
Swaps was similarly flat with July holding at $173.50 to $174, unchanged from late on Friday. August was either side of $177 but activity was slow, said brokers.
